rootCauseProgress.finding: The systemic loop mechanism now includes four proven governance failures: heterogeneous terminalization of historical provider/source/state authority; read-only jobs that still mutate canonical repository state; a provider-read workflow that bypasses its request artifact; and historical lanes that directly connect the legacy TyA database despite the current export/import-only invariant. These are mechanism-level causes, not isolated UI symptoms.
rootCauseProgress.fixModel: Finish exhaustive F0 inventory; in F1 atomically tombstone every residual historical provider/source/state/legacy-connectivity authority; in F2 require frozen master-plan + continuity-lock + consumed-ledger validation before provider access, legacy access or repository state mutation, with direct legacy DB connectivity structurally forbidden. Only then revalidate and execute G2-B under a new explicit one-shot authorization.
